fields.description: Umbrella issue for changes/additions to JUnit test cases, setup and config.

comments.body:
List of missing test-cases (incomplete to be updated):
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

- tests for same-named Node and Property below a given Node.
  this was forbidden with JCR 1.0 and is now a mandatory feature (according to the latest info available)
  test should be created for
  - addNode
  - setProperty
  - move
  - copy
  - ...

- test for the correct version being displayed in the jcr-version descriptor

- Node.getIdentifier

- Node.setPrimaryType

- NodeTypeManager.hasNodeType(String)

- Illegal characters in JCR Name (and thus Path). Set of illegal characters has changed since JCR 1.0
modified versioning tests to cover jcr2.0 api (incomplete).
API coverage as of May 22 (82%); mainly node type management, new property types and advanced versioning missing.
Tests for the JCR-2.0 binary value object.
Binary tests added with revision 779583; thanks Manfred.
javax.jcr.Repository is not included in the API coverage report

This was caused by a syntax error in the exclude file, which attempted to exclude two variants of the login method but in the end excluded the whole class (note this problem was already present in the 1.0 TCK).

Looks promising! The only methods with no TCK tests touching them are:

    VersionManager.merge(String, String, boolean, boolean)
    VersionManager.merge(Node)
i will take care of those.

added test cases that cover the 2 signatures mentioned above:
- MergeActivityTest
- MergeShallowTest
API coverage as of Aug 06: 522/522. Hurray!
The test suite has reached 100% API coverage for JCR 2.0, therefore closing the issue.
